QUORADOR

Outwit · Block · Reach
Arrow keys / WASD to move · R to rotate wall · Esc for menu

How To Play

Standard Quoridor rules — reach the far side before your opponent, or wall them into a longer road.
↑
Move your pawnStep one square up, down, left, or right toward the opposite edge of the board.
▢
Or place a wallEach turn, move OR drop a two-cell wall to lengthen your opponent's road. You start with 10 walls.
⛓
Never a total blockadeA wall may never seal off either player's only path to their goal — the game rejects such placements automatically.
☉
JumpingLand on your opponent's square? Hop straight over them — or diagonally around, if a wall or the board's edge is behind them.
🏆
Win the raceFirst pawn to reach any square on the opposite starting row wins the game.
